bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; establishing a plant-based foods production training pilot program; appropriating money; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 136A.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[136A.247] PLANT-BASED FOODS PRODUCTION TRAINING PILOT PROGRAM.

The commissioner of higher education shall establish and administer a plant-based foods production training pilot program to award grants to secondary career and technical education programs and institutions of higher education for the purpose of offering instruction in plant-based food production. The commissioner must give priority to institutions that coordinate with local producers of plant-based foods. Grants may be used for costs, including but not limited to:

(1) equipment required to produce plant-based foods;

(2) facility renovations to accommodate plant-based food production; and

(3) training faculty to teach the fundamentals of plant-based food production.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATION.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of higher education for the plant-based foods production training pilot program under Minnesota Statutes, section 136A.247. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2027.
additions: [136A.247] PLANT-BASED FOODS PRODUCTION TRAINING PILOT PROGRAM.

The commissioner of higher education shall establish and administer a plant-based foods production training pilot program to award grants to secondary career and technical education programs and institutions of higher education for the purpose of offering instruction in plant-based food production. The commissioner must give priority to institutions that coordinate with local producers of plant-based foods. Grants may be used for costs, including but not limited to:
(1) equipment required to produce plant-based foods;
(2) facility renovations to accommodate plant-based food production; and
(3) training faculty to teach the fundamentals of plant-based food production.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of higher education for the plant-based foods production training pilot program under Minnesota Statutes, section 136A.247. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2027.
